## Description

A rigid euglenoid (no metaboly), flat as a leaf (37–80 × 30–50 µm), with a caudal spine, a flagellum
as long as the body, an eyespot and two large paramylon grains. Phototroph: it does not phagocytose.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 6 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A phototactic flagellate whose oblique, slightly curved caudal spine is a
[body process](../../mechanics/shape-changes.md#silhouettes-and-processes) (the pellicle itself extends).
